structure: repos/trade-imports-animals-frontend (on main) is the live-animals import notification frontend: a Hapi and Nunjucks service whose pages come from a set-agnostic journey platform under src/server/app/ plus one set, src/server/app/sets/live-animals/ (there is still no germinal-products set in the repo). The set holds four things. (1) journeys/linear/features/: 18 feature folders, each one page or a small group of pages, with page.js (id, slug, collects, maturity), controller.js (routes and handlers), template.njk, validate.js, a copy/ folder of copy.en.js and copy.cy.js, and a co-located Playwright fit spec; the bigger features (commodities, transport, addresses, documents, check-answers) hold sub-page folders and a fit/ folder. The contact feature folder and its contact-address section have been removed from the journey since the last extract. (2) journeys/linear/flow/: the 7 journey sections and their page order (start, about-the-consignment, description-of-the-goods, transport-and-arrival, documents, consignment-parties, review, the last gated on readyForCheckYourAnswers), task rows and row status, the entry guard, and section captions with their own copy. (3) obligations/: index.js and 11 section files saying which answers are in scope, mandatory and at what cardinality. (4) services/commodities/: the commodity reference client, its rules and its stub. src/server/app/routes-live-animals.js mounts the set as a Hapi plugin and takes its route list from features/index.js, which imports 27 controller route bundles; src/server/app/flow/ holds the generic dispatch, gates, prerequisites and navigation the set configures. src/server/app/shared/ (23 files) holds the layout, the kit, the Save and continue and Save and return buttons, the trail, the error summary and the service-wide copy; src/server/app/page-maturity/ renders a maturity banner; src/server/common/components/ holds the accessible-autocomplete, multi-select-search and submitted-search macros and the remove-action button helper, and src/client/ their client-side JavaScript plus the service's custom SCSS (notification list, pagination, date picker, commodity total, summary-card error, task list, icon button). Two decision ledgers exist: src/server/app/docs/decisions.md (platform architecture decisions) and src/server/app/sets/live-animals/docs/page-design.md (785 lines, a per-page design-decision record), beside journey-flow-and-gates.md, features.md, limits.md, obligation-model.md and copy-status.md. Fit specs sit both inside the features (30 *.fit.spec.js files) and at the repo root (fit/live-animals-journey.js, which drives the whole happy path page by page, and fit/journey-smoke.fit.spec.js). The scoped source comes to roughly 40,000 lines, cut here into 19 parts along the same seams as the last extract, so each old claim stays with the part whose slice holds its ref. What the scope leaves out, and so stays unclaimed: the co-located *.test.js unit tests, which the scope does not name; the platform layers it does not name (engine/, bridge/, model/, lib/, analysis/, auth/, services/ other than the set's own commodity service, and the persistence and session records); journeys/linear/fixtures/ (characterisation-oracles.json and characterisation-corpus.js, generated test oracles); the stylesheet index and variable files under src/client/stylesheets/ that only import or name colours; and the how-to recipes under both docs/ folders (add-a-set.md, add-a-page.md, add-a-field.md, add-a-section.md, add-a-collection.md, architecture.md, testing.md, test-ownership.md, services.md, persistence.md, validation.md, scope-and-wipe.md, engine.md, cardinality.md, analysis.md, lighthouse.md), which say how to change the code rather than what it does today. There is no machine-readable rulings ledger such as spec/decisions.json; the two markdown ledgers above are what the repo keeps. Welsh copy (copy.cy.js) is read for key parity with the English file rather than claimed string by string.
